project_type: .NET monorepo - ASP.NET Boilerplate framework with multiple NuGet packages
build_system: dotnet CLI with .sln file. Uses common.props for shared NuGet metadata and configureawait.props for Fody/ConfigureAwait. Directory.Build.props at root.
test_framework: xUnit with test projects under test/ directory
verification_instructions: 1. Run dotnet build src/Abp.Mapperly/Abp.Mapperly.csproj and confirm it compiles without errors. 2. Verify the project is added to Abp.sln via dotnet sln list.
snapshot_or_generated_files: FodyWeavers.xsd is auto-generated by Fody during build. It should be committed.
setup_instructions: dotnet restore is sufficient. .NET 10.0.100 SDK is pre-installed. global.json pins to 10.0.100 with rollForward: latestFeature.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access for NuGet packages. .NET SDK 10.0.100 available.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing project structure conventions. Each package lives in src/<PackageName>/ with a subfolder for the main namespace. Include FodyWeavers.xml, FodyWeavers.xsd, Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs. Import common.props and configureawait.props.
key_patterns: 1. ABP modules inherit from AbpModule with PreInitialize/Initialize/PostInitialize lifecycle. 2. Configuration interfaces registered in PreInitialize, accessed via IModuleConfigurations extension methods. 3. IObjectMapper from Abp.ObjectMapping has Map<TDestination>(object), Map<TSource,TDestination>(source,destination), ProjectTo<TDestination>(IQueryable). 4. ReplaceService<IObjectMapper, ConcreteMapper>() in PreInitialize to swap mapper. 5. ITypeFinder injected into module for assembly scanning. 6. Castle Windsor for DI (Component.For<T>().Instance(x).LifestyleSingleton()). 7. File-scoped namespaces used (C# 10 style). 8. RootNamespace set to 'Abp' so namespace is Abp.Mapperly. 9. Solution GUID for 'src' folder is {DFF0464B-5402-4DD6-86F5-2AEC1163B232}.
directory_structure: src/ contains all packages (Abp, Abp.AutoMapper, Abp.EntityFramework, etc). test/ contains test projects. Each src package has: <PackageName>.csproj, FodyWeavers.xml, FodyWeavers.xsd, Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs, and a subfolder with the main code (e.g., AutoMapper/ for Abp.AutoMapper).
